figures.caption: Table 1: Simulation results for CIPS policy with constant δ.

Figure 1: Cross-fitted CIPS estimates of the direct (τDAT T (δ), left) and spillover (τSAT T (δ), right) effects on individual log labour income, over the CIPS odds multiplier δ. Red dots are point estimates and vertical bars are 95% confidence intervals; the dashed line marks the null. The direct effect is negative but insignificant; the spillover effect is significantly negative throughout and strengthens with δ.
